headline: Every Bar Points to Houston
caption:
Three factors, one direction. Watch where they all go.

The biggest push is tonight's players: who is actually suiting up moves our model 6.0 points toward Houston. Recent point differential adds 4.2 more, and team efficiency nudges in another 0.2. Stack that on the average-game baseline (home team by 2.3) and the Rockets come out clear favorites.

Model pick: Houston Rockets, 85% to win. Strong, not a lock. Dallas still takes this one about 15 times in 100.

Does Dallas find a way, or does Houston make the model look smart?
